title: Dr Chama Felix Adanaa: TETFund NRF grant, 2024 cycle
summary: Dr Adanaa received a TETFund National Research Fund grant in the 2024 cycle as Principal Researcher. NRF proposals are screened and approved at national level, which makes this award one of the most competitive research grants in Nigeria. In August 2025 the Federal Government approved ₦4.25 billion for 158 projects under this cycle.
